dct_description_sm: Wapusk National Park (WNP) is located in northwestern Manitoba within the Hudson Bay Lowlands. The goals of this work were to (1) examine the ecological variability of lakes and ponds within Wapusk National Park, (2) characterize the limnology of lakes and ponds in each of three main landscape units of the park (spruce bog, interior peatlands and coastal fens), and (3) assess factors determining the species composition of zooplankton within the ponds, including the relative importance of environmental conditions and dispersal of individuals among ponds.  Funding for this research was provided as part of the 'Arctic Freshwater Systems: Hydrology and Ecology' project from the Canadian federal International Polar Year program.
dct_title_s: Limnological Survey of Freshwater Ponds and Lakes in Wapusk National Park, 2008
